blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) on Monday, Nov. 23, said it will meet with officials of the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA) to discuss disability sensitivity in relation to a video from a Pinoy Big Brother (PBB): Collab 3.0 episode. This, as the MTRCB received the NCDA’s letter regarding a video depicting some housemates “imitating speech characteristics associated with persons with disabilities (PWD).” The meeting with NCDA Executive Director Glenda Relova and Jayme Mariño, chief of NCDA’s Information, Education and Communication Division, will be held on Tuesday, Nov. 24, the MTRCB said.
